{{Quote|Halt! What's your business here, merchants?|The guard to C-3PO and Mungo Baobab|<ref name="TFC" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] worked as a '''guard''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], they were distracted by the Human [[Mungo Baobab]]'s [[mupple pie]] and mistakenly allowed [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to escape from the [[Fortress of Tawntoom|fortress]] that they had been tasked with guarding.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Move along.''"<br />"''They're free.|The guard and Mungo Baobab, the latter of whom offering free pies|<ref name="TFC" />}}
[[File:GuardsEatingPie-TFC.png|thumb|left|250px|The guards enjoying some pie]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]] worked for [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="TFC" /> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}} establishes that ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'', which includes the appearance of [[mupple]] [[Pie/Legends|pies]] in "[[The Frozen Citadel]]," takes place fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the guard was tasked with guarding Koong's [[Fortress of Tawntoom]] on Roon when the Human [[Mungo Baobab]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], tried to sneak in in order to free friends of theirs. With the infiltrators disguised as [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], the guard inquired of Baobab and C-3PO's business; Baobab tried to distract them with [[mupple pie]]s that he had stolen and was able to do so once he offered the [[Pie/Legends|pies]] at no cost. The guard, along with another Human guard, [[Diet/Legends|ate]] and enjoyed the pies, allowing C-3PO to smuggle in R2-D2.<ref name="TFC" />

The distraction did not hold for long, however, for once the pair of guards were finished with their mupple pie, they immediately clamored for more. It was then that R2-D2 was able to evacuate his targets, [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren]] and [[Nilz Yomm]], so C-3PO pointed to the escaped [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] for the guards to chase after; Baobab then intervened and knocked the guards down.<ref name="TFC" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|More. More!''"<br />"''More pie!|The two guards demand more pie|<ref name="TFC" />}}
The guard was easily distracted by the prospect of free pie. They had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="TFC" />

==Equipment==
Like their partner, the security guard wore a green [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with brown cuffs, brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a brown [[Hat/Legends|cap]] with a spot of yellow on it. They also carried a [[Staff/Legends|staff]]-like [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]].<ref name="TFC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The guard appeared in "[[The Frozen Citadel]]," the thirteenth and final episode of the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] animated series,<ref name="TFC" /> which aired on [[November 30]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
